title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E14 — Second Chance Tournament: Part 2
The Second Chance Tournament continues with two final duels; up first, two runners-up compete to prove they have what it takes to be in the No. 1 spot; then, two smiths whose blades failed to make it to testing go head-to-head.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E15 — Second Chance Tournament: Finals
After winning their duels, the tournament concludes with four remaining smiths in an epic final battle; after a couple of grueling rounds, two survive and head back to their home forges to take on a complex weapon from the "Forged in Fire" vault.

description:

title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E01 — Trial by Fire
An assassin's bullet sparks a global conflict that evolves into one of the deadliest wars in history; a generation of soldiers emerges, including a group of men who will become the most infamous leaders of the 20th century; Jeremy Renner narrates.

title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E02 — A Rising Threat
After the fighting stops, tensions continue to simmer just beneath the surface, and few realize that the seeds of the next great global conflict have already been sown; Jeremy Renner narrates.

title: The World Wars
description:
S01 E03 — Never Surrender
World leaders are called to action as war inevitably breaks out again; the men who came of age during wartime must rely upon experiences to fight a new conflict, as they face the greatest challenge humanity has ever seen; Jeremy Renner narrates.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E06 — Mortar; WWII GIs' Personal Items; Native-American Arrows
Mortar; World War II G.I.'s personal items; American Indian arrows.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E05 — Space Kowboy
Rick and his team restore a NASA helmet from the 1960s Gemini missions; an old picker needs a rusty gas cart fixed-up.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S01 E07 — Brothels & Busses
A young man wants to trade a 1750 blunderbuss for an engagement ring; the shop gets a chance to purchase a fighter jet ejection seat; a man hoping to make his rent wants to pawn an original 1966 Schwinn Stingray bicycle.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S06 E08 — What the Truck
The guys are presented with a 1960s Mercedes Unimog; a guy marches in with a sign that hung on the Berlin Wall; a collection of 1980s Garbage Pail Kids trading cards has Chumlee reliving his childhood.

title: American Restoration
description:
S03 E27 — Big Boom
A 1900s signal cannon is brought into the shop; the shop attempts to hold their first auction; 1950s Italian folding bicycle.

title: American Pickers
description:
S05 E13 — The Belly Dance
Dale gets seriously cranked up over Mike's one-of-a-kind belly tank racer; Tommy's treasure-packed barn yields some incredible railroad relics; Frank steps in to save the day for Mike; Bruce's jam-packed property.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S06 E12 — Like a Rock
A 1955 Chevy pickup is brought to the shop; a guy pops in with a Smith & Wesson top break revolver; Rick and the Old Man are presented with a 1950s admiral's telephone from a U.S. Navy ship.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S06 E06 — Trigger Happy
A rare three-trigger Stevens shotgun is brought into the shop; Corey and Rick are presented with a movie camera used by the U.S. military during WWII; an Abraham Lincoln campaign token comes in on the night shift.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S05 E07 — $ Equals MC2
A limited edition photograph of Albert Einstein comes in the shop; Rick and Corey are presented with a collection of confidential documents from the Pentagon; the Old Man takes the day off to tour a World War II era B-17 Bomber.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S06 E26 — Say It Ain't So
A book signed by "Shoeless" Joe Jackson; Savage Navy pistol; Moonman statue from the MTV Video Music Awards.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S06 E03 — Wild Thing
An A6 Texan fighter plane is brought into the shop; a 1974 VW Thing cruises by; a guy brings in his collection of Civil War-era cannonballs.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S06 E20 — Jet Setters
A guy brings in a Wesson over-and-under pistol; a 19th-century pocket watch is brought into the shop; a collection of Boeing aviation memorabilia is brought in.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S07 E27 — Lunch Larceny
An 1838 Colt Paterson formerly owned by a Civil War colonel; letter written by FDR; Rick's lunch keeps disappearing.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
